### Load packages
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(gridExtra)
library(readr)
install.packages("radiant.data")
library(radiant.data)
```
### Load data
```{r}
setwd("/Users/graceleuchtenberger/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Documents/Density_field/data")
YSI <- read_excel("YSI_06132025_06252025.xlsx")
YSI$datetime <- as.POSIXct(YSI$datetime, format = "%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S")
```

```{r}
ggplot(YSI, aes(x=datetime, y=`Temp ∞C`))+
  geom_line()+
  theme_classic()
```
```{r}
ggplot(YSI, aes(x=datetime, y= `Sal psu`))+
  geom_line()+
  theme_classic()
```

```{r}
ggplot(YSI, aes(x=datetime, y= `ODO mg/L`))+
  geom_line()+
  theme_classic()
```

```{r}
ggplot(YSI, aes(x=datetime, y= pH))+
  geom_line()+
  theme_classic()
```
